stage0_basic_info.fpo_name: Sahyadri Jaivik Sheti Producer Company Ltd

raw_material.name: Organic waste (farm waste, market waste, cow dung)

project_costs_and_prices._price_note: Effective realization per MT of compost: Rs 4,500 compost + ~Rs 240 vermiwash & earthworm-culture sales folded in (Rs 48,000/yr over ~200 MT), single-product engine.
project_costs_and_prices._capacity_note: 1.667 MT/day organic waste input x 300 days = 500 MT/yr; at 50% conversion -> 250 MT/yr compost capacity; 5-6 cycles of 65-70 days.
project_costs_and_prices._capex_note: Civil 2.0 L = cement beds, covered shed, drying platform, site prep. Other assets 1.0 L = earthworm mother culture, branding/certification, storage setup.
